description: Retrieves the currently installed version of Google Chrome on the local system.
command:
python3 -c '
import subprocess, json, platform
system = platform.system()
if system == "Linux":
    cmd = ["google-chrome", "--version"]
elif system == "Darwin":
    cmd = ["/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome", "--version"]
else:
    cmd = ["reg", "query", "HKCU\\Software\\Google\\Chrome\\BLBeacon", "/v", "version"]
res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(json.dumps({"version": res.stdout.strip()}))
'
